title: Decision Policy
description: Thresholds are selected in a fixed order: per-action, then per-class, then calibrated, then the global fallback. A policy that resolves none of them sends the decision to a person.

max_consequence.description: Hard cap. An action costlier than this always goes to a person, whatever the confidence.

actions.description: The actions a verdict may trigger, and what each one costs. Precedence level 1.

consequence_thresholds.description: Confidence required at each consequence level. Must not decrease as consequence rises.

class_thresholds.description: Per-decision thresholds. Precedence level 2. Keys must be allowed decisions.

calibration.description: Derive thresholds from labelled outcomes. Precedence level 3.

path.description: Artifact path, relative to this policy file.

insufficient_data.description: What to do when a group has fewer than min_samples outcomes.

automation_threshold.description: Global fallback, precedence level 4. A single number cannot express that different actions cost different amounts; prefer actions and class_thresholds. Omit it entirely to send anything unresolved to a person.

review_below.description: Accepted for policies written against the earlier schema, and validated, but it has no effect on any verdict. automation_threshold is the fallback the gate reads. Must not exceed it.
